product_one_liner.value: Luciq is an agentic mobile observability platform that helps mobile engineering teams automatically detect, prioritize, and resolve performance issues in iOS and Android apps.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes an agentic mobile observability platform for mobile engineering teams that automatically surfaces, prioritizes, and resolves iOS and Android performance issues. Source: https://www.luciq.ai/

pricing_page.notes: Luciq has a public pricing page headed “Pricing that scales with you.” Source: https://www.luciq.ai/pricing

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The company announcement explicitly says its platform powers apps including DoorDash and T-Mobile, identifying them as users rather than investors or partners. Source: https://luciq.ai/blog/instabug-becomes-luciq | named_customers.0: DoorDash is explicitly named among apps powered by the platform: https://luciq.ai/blog/instabug-becomes-luciq | named_customers.1: T-Mobile is explicitly named among apps powered by the platform: https://luciq.ai/blog/instabug-becomes-luciq

employee_band.notes: The company’s Y Combinator profile reports a team size of 250, which falls in the 201–500 band. The figure is a profile-reported count rather than an audited current headcount. Source: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/luciq

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The DPA identifies Luciq’s principal place of business as 230 California Street, San Francisco, California. This is used as the headquarters location. Source: https://www.luciq.ai/dpa | hq_country: The privacy policy places the company in the United States, and the DPA identifies the San Francisco address as its principal place of business. Sources: https://www.luciq.ai/privacy and https://www.luciq.ai/dpa

founded_year.notes: The company’s history says its founders started the business in 2013. This primary-source account is preferred over conflicting third-party dates. Source: https://www.luciq.ai/life-at-luciq

eng_blog.notes: The engineering index links multiple internal engineering write-ups. The CI post by Hesham Abd-Elmegid explains the company’s SDK testing infrastructure; the frontend-testing post credits Menna Ali and Radwa Saeed and explains its Cypress-based migration and release testing. These concern building the company’s own product, not merely general tutorials. Sources: https://www.luciq.ai/category/engineering, https://www.luciq.ai/blog/setting-up-ios-ci-infrastructure-buildkite-anka and https://www.luciq.ai/blog/why-we-automated-our-front-end-testing-at-instabug

public_docs.notes: The public documentation covers SDK setup, dashboard use, CLI and API workflows, and includes separate substantive AI-feature and subprocessor pages. It is not a lone FAQ. Sources: https://docs.luciq.ai/, https://docs.luciq.ai/product-guides-and-integrations/product-guides/ai-features and https://docs.luciq.ai/organization-settings/others/sub-processors

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Product Manager–AI listing is marked Hiring, Vacant position and Apply. Its title satisfies the specified AI-title rule. Confidence is reduced because this third-party listing is explicitly marked Unverified and could not be independently confirmed on the employer’s board. Source: https://theorg.com/org/luciq/jobs/product-manager-ai-df3d5c4e

model_provider.notes: The subprocessor table explicitly lists OpenAI, LLC for AI-powered product features, establishing actual product use rather than merely an integration. No specific model version is asserted. Source: https://docs.luciq.ai/organization-settings/others/sub-processors

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The FAQ explicitly claims SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001:2022 certification and GDPR compliance. GDPR is included as a requested compliance claim, not described as an independent certification. Source: https://www.luciq.ai/faq | compliance_certs.0: The company FAQ explicitly claims SOC 2 Type II certification: https://www.luciq.ai/faq | compliance_certs.1: The company FAQ explicitly claims ISO 27001:2022 certification: https://www.luciq.ai/faq | compliance_certs.2: The company FAQ explicitly claims GDPR compliance with a DPA: https://www.luciq.ai/faq

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The announcement names the round Series B, and the funding-history record identifies that round as the latest. Source: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20220517005310/en/Instabug-Raises-46M-Series-B | funding_date: The latest-round record gives May 17, 2022, matching the dated announcement; normalized to the requested format, this is 2022-05. Source: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20220517005310/en/Instabug-Raises-46M-Series-B | funding_amount_usd: Funding history identifies the May 2022 Series B as the latest round. The company’s announcement states $46 million; the answer uses that publicly announced amount rather than the slightly different database-normalized figure. Source: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20220517005310/en/Instabug-Raises-46M-Series-B

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded round is the Series B announced May 17, 2022, before the 18-month window beginning in May 2025. No newer round was identified in the funding history. Source: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20220517005310/en/Instabug-Raises-46M-Series-B

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Luciq has an Enterprise Account Executive posting, with another listing marked Open for applications and a hiring-board confirmation dated October 6, 2026. These support current AE hiring, although the evidence is from third-party job listings. Sources: https://builtin.com/job/enterprise-account-executive/7195138, https://app.welcometothejungle.com/jobs/1FkPLL6d and https://alion.io/job/luciq-enterprise-account-executive

launched_6mo.notes: The changelog announces the Luciq Agent in-dashboard conversational AI assistant beta on August 5, 2026, within the six-month window. This is a new major capability, not a bug fix or UI adjustment. Source: https://docs.luciq.ai/changelog/rss.xml

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The company announces that Greg Meyer has joined as CFO, and the page’s publication metadata dates the announcement to October 4, 2026, within the 12-month window. Confidence is reduced because the precise employment start date is not separately stated. Source: https://www.luciq.ai/blog/luciq-welcomes-greg-meyer-as-cfo
